changelog: Three fixes from using the previous build. A volume's speed is now measured from the reads a run is actually making, instead of one probe taken at the start: that figure decides how many files are read from a share at once, and it could never correct itself - measured on one share, the ceiling quoted the same 169,8 ms per read all day while that share's own passes measured 1,15 ms per read. A sidecar subtitle is no longer charged for an audio analysis it never uses: a subtitle whose reference can be another subtitle track needs no analysis of the film, so it no longer waits its turn behind a share's read ceiling for a read it never makes - measured, two sidecars of one file now start within 3 ms of each other instead of one after the other. And the row you click now wears the same theme colour a picked row does, instead of a grey that read as a dead row.
description: Synchronize subtitles with video audio using ffsubsync
name: SubSync
overview: Adds a Sync Subtitles action to any video, using ffsubsync as backend
